thread:
Sam T: Escalating a support->CS handoff for BrightCare onboarding. Multiple org users report "magic link" emails fail with 429 when clicking; signups stalled. Support ticket #67890.
Nina P: Saw spike in auth service 429s starting 2026-06-12 09:10 UTC. Rate limiter kicking in for link validation endpoint.
Evan H: Repro steps: create invite, click link from new device -> 429 HTML page. Logs show: 2026-06-12T09:12:03Z WARN auth.rate_limiter deny ip=1.2.3.4 route=/v1/magic/validate
Sam T: Customer is mid-trial with 150 seats planned, renewal/conversion forecast next quarter. This is a conversion risk if >24h. CS please take voice with customer.
Lia (AE): Affected accounts include two enterprise contacts. I need status to brief execs. AE asks for written comms and ETA.
Nina P: Short-term mitigation: temporarily relax rate limit for magic validate for their org_id, or whitelist their IPs. Engineering can push a scoped change within ~60m.
Evan H: I'll open a scoped bypass PR and test. ETA 45-60m if no regressions.
Sam T: Comms owner? Suggest CS own external messages; support to post technical updates.
Lia (AE): Lia happy to loop in execs once we have an ETA. CS please include: cause, ETA, workaround, and next steps.
Nina P: Proposed comms plan: 1) Ack within 15m 2) Offer manual invite links (one-time) or org whitelist 3) ETA for scoped fix 4) Update cadence every 2h until resolved.
Evan H: Ownership: Evan = fix owner, Nina = mitigation owner, Sam = account timeline + customer-facing updates, Lia = AE escalation.
Sam T: I'll send the first ack: "Thanks — investigating. Temporary workaround: request a one-time invite from your CSM or try from a different network; we'll update within 2h."
Support Bot: Ticket #67890 updated by Evan H — bypass PR created: https://support.redwood.com/t/67890#note-3
Evan H: PR deployed to staging, quick smoke looks good. Starting canary to 5% of production traffic now.
Sam T: Customer asked about compensation if SLA impact >12h. Let's propose credit/extended trial if conversion impacted. Lia can confirm plan.
Lia (AE): Confirmed we can offer 30-day trial extension or prorated credit — AE will discuss with customer contingent on final severity.
Nina P: Canary healthy after 20m, no 429s on sample traces. Rolling to 100% now.
Evan H: Deployed to prod at 10:05 UTC. Monitoring activation funnel — seeing new completions.
Sam T: Customer update sent at 10:12 UTC: "Issue identified and fixed; rolling checks show signups progressing. Please reopen if you still see failures."
Lia (AE): Thanks. I'll schedule a renewal prep call with the customer next week and capture any onboarding friction notes.
Sam T: Postmortem actions: 1) Add org-level whitelist flow to runbook 2) Add test for magic link rate behavior in CI 3) Capture onboarding QA checklist. I'll own item 1.
Evan H: Logging improvement ticket created to capture more granular rate-limiter causes.
Sam T: Closing note: conversion risk downgraded to MEDIUM. Follow-up sync scheduled Tue 11:00 PT. Good handoff, thanks team.:thumbsup:
